name: Parry
description: When the bearer is the target of a melee attack action, increase their Fight characteristic by 1.

name: Pierce 1
description: When making an attack action with this weapon, reduce the target’s Armour characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Pierce 2
description: When making an attack action with this weapon, reduce the target’s Armour characteristic by 2 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Two Handed
description: When determining how many melee weapons the bearer is equipped with, this weapon counts as two.

name: Whipcrack
description: When making an attack action with this weapon, unless used as an off-hand weapon, the target cannot make reactions.

name: Unreliable
description: When making an attack action with this weapon, if any hit rolls result in a 1, all hit rolls are discarded and the attack action ends.

name: Reload
description: This weapon must be reloaded after being used for an attack action. A fighter can reload one of their weapons with this special rule when making the wait action.

name: Brace
description: When determining how many ranged weapons a fighter is equipped with, two weapons with this special rule count as one.

name: Blessed
description: When making attack actions against a `VAMPIRE`, `DAEMON` or `THRALL`, increase the Critical Damage characteristic by 1.

name: Blast
description: When making a hit roll with this weapon, for each roll of 6, allocate 2 damage points to another visible fighter within 1” of the target of the attack action.

name: One-use
description: This weapon can only be used for one attack action each battle.

name: Cumbersome
description: When the bearer is the target of a melee attack action, decrease their Fight characteristic by 1.

name: Poisoned
description: After making an attack action with this weapon, if you inflict damage with a critical hit, the target is poisoned. Whenever a poisoned fighter is activated, inflict D3 damage to them.

name: Point Blank
description: This weapon may be used for melee attack actions. Use the bearer’s Shoot characteristic (decreased by 1) instead of their Fight characteristic for the hit rolls.
